title: Which limits refuse the next job
heading: On a MILP, a Row With Slack Can Still Be the Row That Blocks
cases: each candidate job is added alone to the plan, and the limits it breaks are listed
a limit the addition fills exactly is not broken
a candidate that breaks several limits lists all of them, sorted by name
a limit with no room left at the plan is binding, not full-but-not-tight
a limit with room that refuses no candidate is not reported
